YOUR WEB BROWSER / No software to install. Open desktop.axonos.io and go.
Like a video call to your PC
ETHEREUM BLOCKCHAIN / A public, tamper-proof ledger that records your payment. Nobody can fake it.
Can't be paid twice for same tx
AXONOS PLATFORM / Always-on servers that manage access, billing and video. You never see this layer directly.
The front door to your desktop
WebRTC is the primary path in prod
Pauses desktop if credits run out
Always running inside this server: display driver / desktop / backup connection / gateway / API / video encoder / AI assistant / notebooks / file sharing
minutes used = time connected x number of GPUs reserved
desktop pauses (not deleted) when credits run out
WHAT GETS RECORDED IN THE DATABASE
who is connected and which GPUs they have
ETH paid in and minutes remaining
every charge and top-up, full audit trail
Verified Payments / each on-chain transaction stored once - prevents paying the same tx twice
GPU LAUNCHER / Spins up your private desktop on demand.
Counts how many GPUs are free
Each user gets their own bubble
- Dedicated GPU(s) locked to your session
- Connected to the same private network as the gateway
Profiles: small (1 GPU) medium (2) large (4) max (8) -- you choose
Live HD video to your browser
DATABASE / Stores everything reliably. Never loses a record. Shared by all services.
who has a desktop open right now
prevents the same payment being counted twice
YOUR PRIVATE GPU DESKTOP / Created fresh for you. Shut down when your session ends.
Your reserved GPUs (nobody else can use them during your session) ->
Choose 1, 2, 4 or 8 GPUs when you launch / 32 GB shared memory each / AI + CUDA + OpenGL fully available
IMPORTANT: Your desktop is temporary. Files are NOT saved when your session ends. Think of it like a hotel room PC.
Credits that are unused carry over to your next session. Your desktop is paused (not deleted) if you run out of credits mid-session.
Top up within 2 hours to resume exactly where you left off. After 2 hours the paused desktop is removed.
Persistent storage is coming soon. For now: download your work before ending a session.
PHYSICAL SERVER / A real Linux computer with NVIDIA GPUs inside, running in a data center
All the containers above (gateway, database, launcher, your desktop) run on this machine. The NVIDIA GPUs are shared fairly between users via isolated containers.
Each user gets their own sealed-off environment. You cannot see another user's files, processes, or screen. When your session ends, your environment is completely destroyed.
1 Open the website and click "Connect" -> sign a message with your wallet (no password needed, just proves you own the address)
2 Send a small amount of ETH to buy desktop time (~$0.99/hr) -> 3 Choose how many GPUs (1-8) and launch -> 4 Your private Linux desktop starts in seconds -> 5 Use it live in your browser
